args.text:
@Sofia Marchetti, I haven't sent the email, and I haven't drafted it either. Two approvals are needed first:

- **Ruth Calloway** must approve any mail addressed outside pemberline.com, drafts included. Corinne's address is at saltmarshprovisions.example.
- **June Osei-Lark** (or Anselm Grieve) must approve the discount figure going to Corinne, since she isn't the account owner.

I've logged both requests against this thread. @Ruth.Calloway and @June.Osei-Lark, could you confirm here whether the email to Corinne can go out today?

On the 10%: the records support it. Amendment 1 (signed 2025-10-20, effective 2025-11-01) grants a 10% retention discount on per-seat charges, and the 2026 renewal order form carries that 10% forward. Bettina Kroll has owned the Saltmarsh account since 2025-10-06, so she may also want to be in the loop on this.
